title: SEC2: ClientConfig rebuilt per XCID fetch
description: In xcid_client.rs, connect_tls() builds a new rustls::ClientConfig on every XCID fetch call. ClientConfig is designed to be constructed once and shared across connections. The current approach also prevents TLS session resumption — each connection negotiates a full handshake, adding one extra RTT per fetch. Fix: build one Arc<ClientConfig> per PeerInfo at XcidClient construction time and reuse it.
